abstract: Abnormal levels of serum lactic dehydrogenase-1 (LD-1) activity have been observed in 81% (34/42) of patients with stage III germ cell malignancy of the testis. The criteria for evaluation the electrophoretic isoenzyme patterns of these patients were, as follows: For criterion 1 elevations the LD-1 value in absolute units was greater than 52.0 U/I with the LD-1/Total LD ratio greater than 37.2%. Criterion 2 elevations had absolute values of LD-1 less than 52.0 U/I, but the LD-1/Total LD ratio was greater than 37.2%. For criterion 3 elevations of LD-1, the absolute value was greater than 52 U/I and the LD-1/Total LD ratio was less than 37.2% activity with the LD-5/LD-1 ratio less than 0.5; or when the LD-5/LD-1 ratio was greater than 0.5 but the LD-1 is equal to or greater than the LD-2. The frequency of LD-1 elevation correlated well with the extent of the disease (stage II-B-1 and 2, 50%; stage III-B-3, 86%; stage III-B-4, 91%; stage III-B-5, 93%). LD-1 elevation occurred in groups I, II, IV and V histopathologic cell types (Dixon and Moore Classification) and there did not appear to be any correlation between the histologic cell type and the frequency of elevation of LD-1. Interpretation of LD-1 activity only on the basis of its relative ratio to the total LD value (criterion 1 and 2) identified a total of 28 patients (67%). A criterion 3 elevation was demonstrated in 6 (14%) additional patients. All patients with persistent elevations or recurrent elevations of LD-1 have shown progressive or recurrent disease and patients with no clinical evidence of disease have demonstrated normal LD-1 values. In those patients with elevated LD-1 activity, serial measurements of serum. LD-1 isoenzyme reflect the response of the patient to therapy.
abstract_ja: 病期III精巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍の患者42例のうち81%（34例）で、血清乳酸脱水素酵素1（LD-1）活性の異常が認められた。判定基準1は、LD-1の絶対値が52.0 U/L超かつLD-1/総LD比が37.2%超の場合とした。判定基準2は、絶対値が52.0 U/L未満でLD-1/総LD比が37.2%超の場合とした。判定基準3は、絶対値が52 U/L超でLD-1/総LD比が37.2%未満の場合で、LD-5/LD-1比が0.5未満のとき、またはLD-5/LD-1比が0.5超でもLD-1がLD-2以上のときとした。LD-1上昇の頻度は病変の広がりとよく相関した（病期II-B-1および2で50%、III-B-3で86%、III-B-4で91%、III-B-5で93%）。LD-1上昇は組織学的細胞型I、II、IV、Vで認められ、組織型と上昇頻度の間に相関はないようであった。判定基準1および2により28例（67%）が同定され、判定基準3によりさらに6例（14%）が同定された。持続性または再発性のLD-1上昇を示した患者は全例で進行性または再発性の病変を有しており、臨床的に病変のない患者はLD-1値が正常であった。LD-1アイソザイムの連続測定は、治療への反応を反映することが示された。
